evidence_grades.CONFIRMED_PRIMARY: read directly from the v2 full text in this session
evidence_grades.SECONDARY_PENDING_PRIMARY: relayed from the authors' Review Commons response; not verifiable in this session (egress blocked); adopt but re-check against v3 primary text
evidence_grades.CODE_OBSERVED: read from idekerlab/G2PT @ fc13abd; describes the implementation, not necessarily the paper
evidence_grades.UNRESOLVED: paper and code disagree, or neither states it; must be run as a factorial arm, not silently defaulted

_meta.rule: no field may be consumed by training code without its status being logged into the run record

embedding_dim.source: v2 Methods p14: 'The dimension d ... was set to d=64'

n_heads.source: v2 Methods p14: 'The number of heads was set to n=4'

translation_heads.source: v2 Methods p15: Differential Attention, single head n=1

split.source: v2 Methods p16: 'training, validation, and test sets in a 3:1:1 proportion'

optimizer.source: v2 Methods p16: decoupled weight decay (AdamW) + L2

embedding_dim_grid.source: Review Commons; 128 slightly better, 64 chosen for cost

init.code_behaviour: bare nn.Embedding -> N(0,1); only init_method is kaiming_uniform_(a=sqrt(5)), PyTorch's Linear default
init.paper_claim: uniform Xavier for SNP/gene/system embeddings (relayed, unverified)

ffn.code_behaviour: SwiGLU: w12 d->2*inner, F.silu(u)*v, proj inner->d, bias=False
ffn.paper_claim: two-layer position-wise FFN, 4x inner, GeLU (relayed, unverified)

ffn_expansion.source: SwiGLUFFN computes expansion = d_ff // d_model; caller comment says 'usually 4*hidden_size'

batch_size.note: not in v2 Methods, not in the relayed v3 summary

epochs.note: selected by grid search; the grid range itself is unstated

seed.note: upstream training script sets no seed at all; the reproduction fork must add one

propagation_flags.note: which of --sys2env/--env2sys/--sys2gene/--gene2pheno/--sys2pheno reproduce the paper's 5 propagation steps is not stated

_do_not_use.note: two demo configs live in the upstream repo; neither is the paper configuration
